messages:
maria_devex: Heads-up: publish window opens 16:00 PT. Plan: TS pipeline -> smoke -> promote; Py artifacts will be canary but we may hold final on any wheel-signing or checksum errors. @alex_release @sam_swe please ACK and call out blockers.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] starting publish run: cohort canary (sdk-ts, sdk-py) builds ts-912, py-743

alex_release: ACK. Noted intermittent manylinux signing failures overnight. I'll tail the py build logs and try a local wheel verify. If we see hash errors we hold py final and file an incident.

sam_swe: Clarify rollback for TS: if smoke shows infra errors or e2e regressions, we revert npm tag to previous stable and publish a 3.1.1 patch later. Prefer pin-to-stable rather than yank.

qa_ben: Quick smoke now. TS canary looks OK on staging (auth, embeddings, chat). Py canary failing during pip install on ubuntu-22-runner: "ERROR: WHEEL-INVALID (bad hash)". I attached minimal repro in logs.

maria_devex: @alex_release can you attempt a repack with --no-cache and --rebuild-manylinux? If that fails we proceed TS final only and create a holdback for Py.

alex_release: Running repack:
```
./ci/release/run_publish_py.sh --tag canary --no-cache --rebuild-manylinux
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ts publish succeeded: @redwood/sdk-ts@3.2.0-canary -> npm dist-tag 'canary' (ts-912) :white_check_mark:

alex_release: Repack retried but same checksum error on ubuntu-22. Suspect signing agent intermittency with keyserver. Saving logs to https://ci.internal/runs/py-743/logs

qa_ben: TS canary smoke full pass (15/15). Recommend promoting TS to final at 16:20 PT. I will monitor for 20m.

maria_devex: Proceed TS final now. I'll update release notes to mention Py holdback and the deprecation blurb for legacy sync client; set expectation that Py will be delayed until signing is resolved.

sam_swe: For rollback docs: include quick npm pin snippet and docker tag revert steps. Keep the guidance short: how to pin to 3.1.x and where to find CI checks.

alex_release: Promoting TS final: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@3.2.0 stable` and pushing changelog. Opening hold ticket for Py: RHOLD-9981 assigned to @alex_release with logs attached.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ts promote completed: @redwood/sdk-ts@3.2.0 -> dist-tag 'stable' (ts-912) :rocket:

qa_ben: Monitoring metrics. Will escalate if error rate >0.8% or latency regressions >15% p95.

maria_devex: Action items:
- alex_release: create Py republish ticket RHOLD-9981 + retry when signing agent healthy
- alex_release: pin npm and docker tags per release checklist
- qa_ben: monitor TS for 30m
- sam_swe: add rollback snippet to release notes

alex_release: Ticket RHOLD-9981 created and assigned. Adding note to release notes about Py holdback and revised deprecation timeline for sync client.

maria_devex: Thanks all. Closing thread once the monitoring window completes. :thumbsup:
